description: Selected 2026 UK Government GHG conversion factors sourced from revised 31 July 2026 flat workbook; exact source rows checked against official workbook, accounting boundaries not independently assured.

electricity.note: Electricity: UK, generation only; excludes separate Scope 3 transmission and distribution

natural_gas_gross_kwh.note: Owned or controlled natural-gas combustion; use gross CV billing basis

natural_gas_net_kwh.note: Owned or controlled natural-gas combustion; use net CV billing basis

diesel_litres.note: Owned or controlled combustion only; upstream fuel emissions are separate Scope 3

petrol_litres.note: Owned or controlled combustion only; upstream fuel emissions are separate Scope 3

train_national_passenger_km.note: Passenger-kilometres for national rail; upstream fuel may be separate

water_supply_m3.note: Purchased water supply in cubic metres

hotel_uk_room_night.note: Room nights UK, excluding separate London-specific factor

hotel_london_room_night.note: Use London-specific factor only for hotels in London

flight_short_haul_with_rf.subcategory: Short-haul flight average passenger, with radiative forcing
flight_short_haul_with_rf.note: UK short-haul passenger travel; includes RF uplift

flight_short_haul_without_rf.subcategory: Short-haul flight average passenger, without radiative forcing
flight_short_haul_without_rf.note: UK short-haul passenger travel; excludes RF uplift
